headline: Cochin Shipyard Limited: Government of India undertakes offer for sale of 66.29 lakh equity shares via stock exchange mechanism
sum: The Government of India, through the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, launched an offer for sale (OFS) of 66,29,636 equity shares in Cochin Shipyard Limited on the NSE, with non-retail investor bidding on 7 July and retail investor bidding on 8 July 2026. The divestment is part of the ongoing PSU share reduction programme and was executed via stock exchange mechanism.
detail: The President of India, represented by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, announced an offer for sale of 66,29,636 equity shares (face value ₹5 per share) in Cochin Shipyard Limited. The OFS was conducted via NSE's stock exchange mechanism with a two-stage process: non-retail investor bidding opened 7 July 2026 at 9:15 a.m. and closed at 3:30 p.m. the same day; retail investor bidding opened 8 July 2026 at 9:15 a.m. The offer represents a significant portion of Cochin Shipyard's outstanding equity and is part of the Government's divestment strategy for central PSUs.
